gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Note 13 (Technical reserves) At 1 January 2019. The note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' only reports a NET movement (+GBP 8.8m) and cites deterioration on an AXA XL quota share. The gross prior-year strengthening has been calculated by combining the stated net prior-year movement (+GBP 8.8m) with the recorded increase in the reinsurer's share movement from the Technical Reserves reconciliation (reinsurer movement in claims outstanding +GBP 21.92m), giving a gross implied prior-year strengthening of GBP 30.72m. The claims development triangle is present but does not provide an unambiguous standalone gross prior-year figure; therefore the gross figure is derived arithmetic and assigned a calculated confidence (0.8). If strict gross-only movement directly labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision (gross)' were required and not derivable, the field would be null.
